summary: Taken from Me: The Tiffany Rubin Story is a 2011 original LMN movie starring Taraji P. Henson and Terry O'Quinn. The film dramatizes the kidnapping and rescue of Tiffany Rubin's son, who was abducted by his father and taken to South Korea.
one_line: A 2011 LMN original movie starring Taraji P. Henson and Terry O'Quinn about the abduction and rescue of Tiffany Rubin's son from South Korea.
key_facts: Taken from Me: The Tiffany Rubin Story is a 2011 original LMN movie.
The film stars Taraji P. Henson and Terry O'Quinn.
The film follows the events surrounding the kidnapping and rescue of the son of Tiffany Rubin.
Tiffany Rubin's son was kidnapped by his father.
The son was taken to South Korea by his father.
The film is based on the real-life case of Tiffany Rubin.
